Implemented the responsive course registration app with four pages linked through the navigation bar. The catalog has search and filters, course selections persist in browser storage, registration includes a confirmation modal, and the profile shows the selected courses in a table.

The files are [index.html](/work/index.html), [catalog.html](/work/catalog.html), [registration.html](/work/registration.html), [profile.html](/work/profile.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), and [app.js](/work/app.js).

`node --check app.js` passed. I couldn’t run a browser console check because no browser executable is available in the environment.
